name: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, outstanding loan amounts of up to ₹50,000/- in standard crop loan outstanding accounts as of 31st March 2020, will be waived.

**Note:** Repayment of outstanding loan through DBT.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
   1. The age of the farmer should be more than 18 years.
   1. The applicant should be a farmer who self-cultivates their land or cultivates leased land.
   1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer who has availed of the loan through the Kisan Credit Card.
   1. The farmer should have a valid Aadhaar number.
   1. The applicant should be a valid ration card holder.
   1. The applicant should be a Kisan Credit Card holder.
   1. The applicant should be a short-term crop loan holder.
   1. The crop loan should be issued by a recognized bank located in Jharkhand.
   1. The family of the deceased debtor is also eligible under the scheme.
   1. The applicant should have a standard crop loan account.
   1. Only one member per family holding a crop loan will be eligible.
   1. This scheme will be voluntary for all crop loan holders.

**Note:** The applicant has to pay ₹1/- only for the application.
**Eligibility for banks, criteria, determining outstanding loans and deadlines, eligible loan accounts, and exceptions:**

  - Qualified Banks - Commercial Banks, Scheduled Co-operative Banks and Rural Banks
  - Qualifying Loan - Short-Term Crop Loan
  - Eligible period for disbursement - Upto 31.03.2020
  - Qualifying Loan Account - Single &amp;amp; Joint
  - Loans taken for crop diseases
